title: Nashville River Retreat 3BR Center of Town
description:
Unwind on the river! Our 3-bedroom retreat sits right on the water, just 5 minutes to the Grand Ole Opry &  15 minutes to Downtown.

Private waterfront deck
Full kitchen & coffee maker
Washer/Dryer & fast Wi-Fi
Free on-site parking
Reserve your Nashville stay today and wake up to peaceful river views!

The space
Dog friendly. Good size living room area with comfortable seating. 2 bedrooms with queen beds and a good amount of storage. 1 bedroom with a desk and twin size day bed and trundle bed underneath. Washer and Dryer. Smart TV in living room and all bedrooms. WiFi. Screened in patio overlooking the Cumberland River. Fenced in backyard with direct access from inside.

Other things to note
Dog Friendly.
